GitOdile 0.2.0-preview.12

This testing preview changes the project license and hardens the updater after the first public previews updated real installations. It is intended as the target of a preview-to-preview update test from 0.2.0-preview.11, and it is the first preview whose update information carries the real publication time and readable release notes.

- GitOdile is now licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 only (AGPL-3.0-only). Earlier previews were published under MIT and stay that way; this and later versions are AGPL. The About dialog states the license and links to the license text and the source code. The GitOdile name, logo and icon are not covered by the software license; see TRADEMARKS.md.
- A build that cannot install updates by itself says so as soon as it checks, in plain words, and offers the manual download instead of downloading a package and refusing it afterwards.
- Installed clients no longer depend on the update feed listing only the platforms they know. Enabling macOS in the feed later will not stop Windows and Linux installations from updating.
- On Windows, a per-user installation in a custom directory is recognised and can update in place; a machine-wide installation is still directed to the installer.
- Release notes in the update dialog keep their paragraphs and bullets, and the shown publication date is the moment the release was actually published.
- Windows is provided as an NSIS installer. Authenticode remains deliberately deferred, so Windows may show an unknown-publisher or SmartScreen warning.
- Linux is provided as an AppImage.
- Both packages verify updates with the production Tauri updater key and the public preview.json feed in martinezelx/gitodile.
- macOS remains disabled and no macOS package is included.

Publishing this preview does not declare either target qualified and does not authorize stable publication.
